login.point2: Acquire a whole PI per batch, idempotent request no.
login.hint: Accounts are created by the administrator with the company employee number; ask the administrator for your password.

orders.title: Production order snapshot
orders.desc: From Kingdee production orders (planned / plan-confirmed only), stored per material line. Left: totals per order; right: material lines. Orders without a customer are hidden.
orders.syncedRemoved: Order {bill} is no longer planned; removed from the snapshot
orders.excluded: {n} more orders without customer are hidden

sched.title: Scheduled full sync
sched.intervalHint: {min} minutes to 7 days; the next run is counted from now after saving
sched.note: Each run is the same as the Full sync button (operator: system); if Kingdee fails the snapshot is kept and the next cycle retries.

generate.title: Generate & allocate
generate.desc: One row per PI; the button shows the next step, and clicking a row opens the detail panel. Generate: pick a rule and enter the quantity in the panel (defaults to the whole quota; above the default per-run limit it starts at the limit, which you can lift). A PI's bills continue one serial run in bill-number order, and the whole PI is generated in one transaction; a running generation can be cancelled, and failure or cancellation rolls back the whole run; a run can be revoked until it is allocated. Allocate: pending numbers go to each order's production org in one step. If any order's production org is not set up as a factory, the PI cannot be generated.
generate.rulePick: Pick a rule from the rule library, or set one manually
generate.ruleAssigned: Rule bound; generation will use it by default
generate.rulePickRequired: Pick a rule from the rule library, or set one manually
generate.startAdjusted: SN {sn} has been transferred into this PI, so generation starts at {start}
generate.failed: Generation failed and was rolled back: {msg}
generate.allocConfirm: Allocate the {qty} SNs of PI {pi} to each order's production org? They become To acquire.
generate.allocNote: The whole PI is allocated in one go, not order by order. Factories can acquire right after.
generate.recentOnly: Showing the latest {n} pages of PIs (except Generating); search to find older ones
generate.more: Showing the first {n} PIs; type to narrow down
generate.limitHint: The quota is above {n}, so one run defaults to {n}. Tick "Lift the limit" below to generate more at once.
generate.maxHint: At most {n} per run; generate the rest in another run, or ask the administrator to raise the limit.
generate.qtyCorrected: {n} is above the limit; changed to {cap}
generate.runNote: Only the whole PI's progress is shown. You can close the panel or reload the page: generation goes on in the background and the progress is still here when you come back. It only counts once everything is written; on failure or cancel the whole PI rolls back and no SN is kept.
generate.cancelConfirm: Cancel this generation? Every SN written so far will be deleted and the order quotas stay as they are; the cancellation is recorded in the audit log.
generate.canceled: Cancelled; every SN written was deleted
generate.revokeHint: Revoking undoes a whole generation: only the last one in the PI's serial whose SNs are all still to allocate, and all its orders together.
generate.revokeConfirm: Revoke this generation: delete {start} ~ {end} ({qty} SNs, {n} orders), roll back the PI max serial and the order quotas; regenerated SNs will be the same. Reason:
generate.revoked: {qty} SNs revoked; you can generate again

rules.title: Rule library
rules.desc: The rule library only categorizes rules (uncategorized / customer / PI), which doesn't make them take effect; bind rules to a PI on the generation page. Precedence: single PI > assigned to the PI > customer. The prefix is required and must not start with, or be the start of, another rule's prefix; when several PIs use the same rule, later PIs get their own version with _v<version> added to the suffix, so SNs are unique globally. Changing prefix, suffix, base, length or charset edits the current version in place if it has not generated any SN yet, otherwise creates a new version; renaming does not. A new version only applies to SNs generated afterwards.
rules.name: Name
rules.charsetHint: Blank = default charset for the base; a custom one must match the base length without repeats.
rules.editUsed: The current version has been used: changing encoding creates a new version; issued SNs keep the old one.
rules.editUnused: The current version is unused and can be edited in place.
rules.prefixHint: Required; letters, digits and _ only. It must not start with, or be the start of, another rule's prefix (e.g. AX and AXB), so SNs of different rules never collide.
rules.categoryHint: Optional. The category is only for filtering here and finding templates on the generation page; it doesn't make the rule take effect, and a customer or PI can have several. Bind rules to a PI on the generation page.
rules.deleteUsed: A rule that has issued SNs cannot be deleted
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete rule {code} ({name}) and all its versions? This cannot be undone and will be recorded in the audit trail.
rules.deleteBound: This rule is bound to {bind}; after deletion those PIs will no longer use it.

acquire.title: Acquire & print
acquire.desc: One row per PI; the button shows the next step: “Acquire” (to-acquire → to-print), then “Print” (to-print → printed, downloads the print file). SNs pending transfer are excluded. Click a row for segments or to move a material. Batches and print records are on the SN Query page.
acquire.piAllReadOnly: Read-only: SNs of this PI allocated to all factories; acquire/print disabled.
acquire.queryReadOnly: Viewers can only look; acquire/print disabled.
acquire.printConfirm: Mark all {n} SNs of {factory} · PI {pi} as printed and download the print file?
acquire.printed: {n} SNs printed; downloading the print file
acquire.qtyChanged: Processed {n} SNs ({m} shown in the list); the rest were already handled by MES or someone else
acquire.printNothing: These SNs are already printed (reported by MES or printed by someone else first), so the page cannot change them; export the file under SN Query → Acquire batches
acquire.rule: Acquisition is always a whole PI, never per material or single SN. If a material should not stay here, transfer it first, then acquire the rest.
acquire.bulkTakeConfirm: Acquire all {q} to-acquire SNs of the {n} selected PIs?
acquire.bulkPrintConfirm: Mark all {q} to-print SNs of the {n} selected PIs as printed and download the print files?
acquire.recentOnly: Showing the {n} most recently active pages; search by PI to find older ones
acquire.emptyALL: No PI to acquire, print or pending transfer
acquire.filesHint: Bulk print finished. Browsers may block multiple downloads, so download each file here. You can also download them later under SN Query → Print records.

transfer.title: Factory transfer
transfer.desc: SNs that are to-acquire, to-print or printed can move; the source is limited to one PI. A factory request puts SNs into pending; HQ approval moves them to the target (to-acquire there); rejection or withdrawal restores them. Any duplicate full SN in the target PI rejects the whole transfer.
transfer.targetDisabledTip: The target factory is disabled; reject the request, or enable the factory first
transfer.jumpWarn: After this transfer PI {pi} will generate from {after} (was {before}); {unused} numbers will never be generated
transfer.rule: SNs to allocate or pending transfer cannot move; one open request per SN.
transfer.applyConfirm: The {n} SNs become pending until HQ decides. Target: {factory} · {pi}. Continue?
transfer.approveConfirm: Approve {no} ({n} SNs)? They move to the target as to-acquire.
transfer.rejectConfirm: Reject {no} ({n} SNs)? They return to their previous status.
transfer.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw {no}? SNs return to their previous status.
transfer.noMaterials: Enter the source factory and PI first
transfer.manualEntry: Not listed? Enter the target manually
transfer.applyNote: After submitting, these SNs become pending transfer and cannot be acquired or printed until HQ decides.
transfer.directNote: After submitting, these SNs move to the target and become to-acquire in the target factory.
transfer.chkSource: Enter source factory, PI and scope
transfer.chkTarget: Choose the target factory and PI

query.title: SN query
query.desc: Read-only; SNs cannot be moved here. SN details by filter; batches and print records can be found by batch no., print no. or request no. (including MES API acquisitions), and print files can be downloaded again.
query.capped: More than {n} results; narrow the filter or export.
query.seqRangeTip: Fill in the PI to search by serial range. Enter serials (leading zeros optional) or full SNs; both ends are included, and an empty end means no limit. Only serials generated by this PI are searched; SNs transferred into this PI are not.
query.rangeMissing: The range should hold {expected} SNs; {n} are not in the results (not generated, transferred out, or excluded by other filters)
query.rangeFull: Every SN in the range is present

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.retention: Kept for {days} days; expired months are archived.
audit.archiveKeep: Archived entries are kept until {days} days after they happened, then removed automatically.
audit.archiveSpan: Searches covering archived dates include them (archive covers {from} ~ {to}).

users.title: Accounts
users.desc: Accounts use the unique company employee number. Accounts are disabled, never deleted; disabled accounts cannot sign in and their history is kept. New accounts sign in directly with the password set at creation; after an administrator reset, the password must be changed at next sign-in.
users.name: Name
users.pwdHint: Usable right away; the user can change it at any time.

roleHint.admin: HQ: no factory, full business permissions, may act for any factory; cannot create or manage accounts (only the admin account can).
roleHint.factory_operator: Must be bound to one factory and can only act for it.
roleHint.query: Read-only; bind one or more factories to see only those; none selected = all factories.

users.disableConfirm: Disable {emp} {name}? They can no longer sign in; history is kept.
users.resetPrompt: New initial password for {emp} (must change at next sign-in)
users.resetDone: Password reset; the account must change it at next sign-in

factories.title: Factories
factories.desc: Factories are Kingdee production organizations, matched by name in the order snapshot. Manually entered transfer targets must be existing factories.
factories.name: Name
factories.nameHint: The name must equal the production org name on Kingdee orders to match.
factories.renameHint: Snapshot production orgs match factories by name: the new name must equal the production org name on Kingdee orders, otherwise those orders become "not set up" and cannot be generated.
factories.disableHint: Factories are disabled, never deleted. A disabled factory can no longer be a target for generation, allocation or transfers, nor be bound to accounts; SNs already allocated to it can still be acquired, printed, called back and transferred out, and its accounts stay active. Kingdee factories follow the org's forbid status on sync.
factories.disableConfirm: Disable factory "{name}"? It can no longer be generated for, allocated to, transferred into or bound to accounts; SNs already allocated there can still be acquired and printed. {n} active accounts are bound to it and stay active.
